Défibrillateur externe automatisé

A portable device used to deliver an electric shock to restore normal heart rhythm during sudden cardiac arrest on board.

Quick answer: A portable device used to deliver an electric shock to restore normal heart rhythm during sudden cardiac arrest on board.

Definition
